products.title: Garnier Hyaluron Barrier Repair Gel – 50ml
products.description:
Reset your skin's moisture defense. When your skin's natural barrier gets compromised by pollution, harsh weather, or stress, it loses moisture fast. The Garnier Hyaluron Barrier Repair Gel is your daily solution to repair, lock in deep hydration, and shield your skin from environmental aggressors.

This ultra-lightweight gel moisturizer is powered by pure Hyaluronic Acid, which acts like a sponge holding up to 1,000 times its weight in water. Blended with a soothing repair complex, it absorbs instantly into the skin without feeling heavy or sticky. It delivers continuous 48-hour moisture while working to physically strengthen your skin's outer barrier, leaving your face feeling plump, calm, and perfectly balanced.

Why You’ll Love It (Key Benefits):

  • Instant & Lasting Hydration: Pure hyaluronic acid delivers a deep surge of moisture that keeps your skin looking plump all day.

  • Barrier Repair Formula: Clinically designed to strengthen skin defense systems and prevent moisture loss.

  • Non-Sticky Gel Texture: The refreshing, oil-free gel formula absorbs rapidly and is perfect for oily, combination, and sensitive skin types.

  • Safe for Sensitive Skin: Hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic, and dermatologically tested so it won't clog your pores.

How to Use:

  1. Cleanse your face and neck thoroughly.

  2. Smooth a small amount of the gel over your face using light, upward strokes.

  3. Use morning and night for continuous barrier support and hydration.

products.title: e.l.f. Cosmetics Complexion Brush
products.description:
Flawless Diffusion. Natural Perfection. Achieve a seamless, "filter-free" look with the e.l.f. Cosmetics Complexion Brush. This oversized, multi-tasking tool is expertly designed to distribute powder products evenly across the skin for a soft-focus finish. Whether you are setting your foundation, applying a pop of blush, or warming up your face with bronzer, this brush provides the perfect balance of density and softness for an effortless application every time.

✨ Why the Complexion Brush is a Fan Favorite:

  • Oversized & Ultra-Soft: The large, fluffy head allows for a quick and even application of product over the entire face without creating harsh lines.

  • 100% Synthetic & Anti-Bacterial: Made with high-quality, animal-hair-free bristles that are softer and more absorbent than ever. These synthetic fibers are designed to be hygienic and easy to clean.

  • Wet & Dry Versatility: While it excels with powders, this brush is also compatible with cream and liquid formulas, making it a truly versatile addition to your beauty routine.

  • Sculpt & Blend: The unique shape is dense enough to sculpt features beautifully yet airy enough to blend products into a sheer, natural-looking glow.

✨ Pro-Tips for a Professional Complexion:

  1. Setting Your Base: Swirl the brush into a translucent or setting powder and tap off the excess. Use broad, sweeping motions starting from the center of the face and moving outward to set your foundation for all-day wear.

  2. Seamless Blushing: Dip into your favorite blush and apply to the "apples" of your cheeks, blending upward toward the temples for a lifted, radiant look.

  3. The "No-Makeup" Glow: Use the brush to apply a light dusting of bronzer to the areas where the sun naturally hits (forehead, cheekbones, and nose) for a sun-kissed appearance without any heavy buildup.

  4. Easy Cleaning: To maintain the performance and softness of the bristles, clean regularly with a gentle brush shampoo and lay flat to dry to prevent water from damaging the handle.

products.title: Bluma Milk & Honey Flower Body Wash (1000ml / 33.8 oz)
products.description:
Classic Softness. Natural Nourishment. Indulge in one of beauty’s most time-honored combinations with the Bluma Milk & Honey Body Wash. This premium Italian "Bagnoschiuma" is infused with the natural goodness of milk proteins and honey extract to provide a deeply moisturizing and soothing bath experience. Designed to cleanse without irritation, it leaves your skin feeling exceptionally smooth, supple, and delicately scented with a warm, comforting aroma.

✨ Why Milk & Honey is a Skincare Powerhouse:

  • Deeply Moisturizing: Honey is a natural humectant, meaning it draws moisture into the skin, while milk proteins help to soften and smooth the skin's surface.

  • Rich in Nutrients: This formula is naturally high in antioxidants, vitamins, and minerals that nourish the skin barrier and help protect against environmental dryness.

  • Soothing & Calming: The anti-inflammatory properties of honey make this wash ideal for soothing sensitive or reactive skin, reducing redness and irritation.

  • Active Natural Emollients: Like all Bluma products, this wash uses active emollients of natural origin to maintain your skin’s hydration levels long after you've dried off.

✨ Performance & Safety Benefits:

  • Dermatologically Tested: Scientifically formulated and derma-tested to be safe for the entire family, including those with dry or sensitive skin.

  • pH Balanced & Gentle: Helps maintain the skin's natural balance, ensuring it feels fresh and rejuvenated rather than tight or stripped.

  • Luxurious Lather: Creates a rich, creamy foam that turns an ordinary shower into a spa-like retreat.

  • Large 1000ml Value Size: Housed in a generous 1-Liter bottle, providing long-lasting value for daily full-body care.

✨ How to Use for Maximum Softness:

  1. The Comforting Shower: Apply to a wet sponge or loofah and massage into a rich lather. The warm steam will release the sweet scent of honey, helping you relax.

  2. The "Milk Bath" Experience: Pour a generous amount under warm running water to create a creamy, skin-softening bubble bath—the ultimate way to unwind after a long day.

  3. Post-Shower Care: For the ultimate hydration routine, follow up with Cosmo Cocoa Butter or Avocado Body Cream to lock in the nutrients from the milk and honey.

products.title: Bluma Coconut Moisturizing Body Wash 33.8 fl oz
products.description:
Italian Elegance. Timeless Freshness. Elevate your bathing ritual with the Bluma White Musk Body Wash. Crafted with the heritage of Italian beauty, this "Bagnoschiuma" (bath foam) delivers a luxurious, multi-sensory experience. Infused with a delicate white musk fragrance, it cleanses your skin while leaving a soft, powdery scent that evokes the feeling of fresh linens and pure serenity.

✨ Why Bluma White Musk is a Luxury Favorite:

  • Active Natural Emollients: Formulated with emollients of natural origin, this body wash ensures that your skin remains hydrated and velvety-soft, even after a long soak or hot shower.

  • The "Clean" Fragrance: White musk is celebrated for its balanced, non-overwhelming aroma. It provides a sophisticated "soap-and-water" freshness that is perfect for both men and women.

  • Derma-Tested & Safe: This gentle formula is dermatologically tested and free from harsh synthetic fragrances and aggressive chemicals, making it safe for all skin types—including sensitive and dry skin.

  • Made in Italy: Proudly produced in Italy, Bluma represents the finest in European personal care, focusing on natural ingredients and holistic well-being.

✨ Performance Benefits:

  • Rich Lathering: A small amount creates a dense, creamy foam that effectively removes impurities while pampering the skin.

  • Versatile Cleansing: Gentle enough to be used as a full-body wash or poured under running water to create a relaxing, fragrant bubble bath.

  • Long-Lasting Aroma: The elegant musk notes are designed to linger subtly on the skin, providing a sense of comfort throughout the day or night.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. In the Shower: Apply to a damp sponge or loofah. Massage over the body to create a rich foam, then rinse for skin that feels instantly refreshed and moisturized.

  2. In the Bath: Pour a generous amount under warm, running water to create a plush bubble bath. The steam will release the musk aromatics, helping to calm the mind and body.

  3. Layering: For a truly "Legendary" grooming experience, follow up with a woody or fresh fragrance like Montblanc Explorer; the white musk base provides a clean canvas for your signature scent.

products.title: CeraVe Facial Moisturizing Lotion PM
products.description:
Restore. Replenish. Recover. Give your skin the nightly care it deserves with the CeraVe Facial Moisturizing Lotion PM. This ultra-lightweight, oil-free formula is specifically designed to work with your skin’s natural circadian rhythm, helping to rebuild the skin barrier while you sleep. Developed with dermatologists, it provides a steady stream of moisture and essential nutrients, ensuring you wake up to a hydrated, calm, and healthy-looking complexion.

✨ Why it’s a Nighttime Essential:

  • MVE Delivery Technology: CeraVe’s patented Multivesicular Emulsion (MVE) technology ensures a slow, controlled release of moisturizing ingredients over 24 hours, providing long-lasting hydration well into the morning.

  • The "Power of Three" Ceramides: Like all CeraVe products, this lotion is formulated with three essential ceramides (1, 3, and 6-II) that help restore and maintain the skin's natural protective barrier.

  • Hyaluronic Acid: Attracts and retains moisture at the skin's surface, plumping the appearance of fine lines and preventing overnight dehydration.

  • Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): Helps to soothe the skin, reduce the appearance of redness, and improve overall skin texture and tone.

✨ Performance Benefits:

  • Ultra-Lightweight Texture: The unique liquid-lotion consistency absorbs instantly without a heavy or greasy feel—perfect for all skin types, including oily and combination skin.

  • Non-Comedogenic: A breathable, oil-free formula that is guaranteed not to clog pores or cause breakouts.

  • Fragrance-Free & Gentle: Formulated to be non-irritating, making it a safe choice for those with sensitive skin or conditions like rosacea.

  • Nighttime Focused: Specially formulated without SPF to allow the skin to focus purely on repair and hydration during sleep.

✨ How to Apply for Best Results:

  1. Cleanse: Start with a gentle cleanser to remove makeup, oil, and impurities from the day.

  2. Prep: If you use serums (like Retinol or Vitamin C), apply them first and allow them to absorb fully.

  3. Apply: Smooth a small amount of the PM Lotion onto the face and neck using upward, circular motions.

  4. The "Neck & Chest" Rule: Don't stop at the jawline; extend the application to your neck and décolletage, as these areas also lose moisture overnight.

products.title: Cosmo Avocado Nourishing Body Cream (500ml)
products.description:
Superfood for Your Skin. Experience the ultimate in deep hydration with the Cosmo Avocado Body Cream. Harnessing the power of one of nature’s most nutrient-dense superfoods, this rich, emollient cream is designed to replenish and revitalize dehydrated skin. Packed with healthy fats, vitamins, and antioxidants, it provides a soothing "moisture wrap" that restores elasticity and leaves your skin feeling incredibly soft and resilient.

✨ Why Avocado Oil is a Skincare Essential:

  • Deep Tissue Penetration: Avocado oil is unique for its ability to penetrate deeper into the skin layers than most other fruit oils, providing intense nourishment where it’s needed most.

  • Rich in Oleic Acid: High levels of healthy fatty acids help to repair the skin’s natural lipid barrier, locking in moisture and protecting against environmental dryness.

  • Vitamin Surge: Infused with Vitamins A, D, and E, this cream supports skin cell regeneration and helps to soothe inflammation or itchiness caused by extreme dryness.

  • Collagen Support: The nutrients in avocado are known to help support natural collagen production, aiding in keeping the skin looking firm and youthful.

✨ Performance Benefits:

  • Soothes Sensitive Skin: The natural, calming properties of avocado make this an excellent choice for those with sensitive or easily irritated skin.

  • 24-Hour Moisture Lock: Provides a heavy-duty moisture barrier that keeps skin hydrated from one shower to the next.

  • Non-Sticky Texture: Despite its intensive hydrating properties, the cream is formulated to absorb cleanly, leaving a smooth, supple finish without a greasy film.

  • Value-Sized Jar: The 500ml capacity is perfect for generous, daily full-body application, ensuring your skin stays nourished all month long.

✨ How to Apply for Best Results:

  1. Seal in Moisture: For the best results, apply to warm, damp skin immediately after bathing to "trap" water in the skin cells.

  2. Night-Time Recovery: Use as an overnight treatment for very dry areas like shins and arms to wake up to transformed, hydrated skin.

  3. The Gentle Massage: Use slow, upward strokes to help the rich avocado nutrients absorb fully while stimulating healthy circulation.

products.title: Cosmo Papaya Brightening Body Cream (500ml)
products.description:
Smooth. Brighten. Renew. Unveil a more radiant complexion with the Cosmo Papaya Body Cream. This high-performance moisturizer harnesses the natural power of Papaya Extract to gently exfoliate and revitalize dull, tired skin. Rich in enzymes and antioxidants, this cream works to improve skin clarity and texture while providing the deep, lasting hydration your body needs to stay soft and supple.

✨ Why Papaya Extract is the Ultimate Glow-Getter:

  • Natural Enzymatic Exfoliation: Papaya contains Papain, a natural enzyme that helps dissolve dead skin cells on the surface. This gentle renewal process reveals the fresh, glowing skin underneath without the need for harsh scrubs.

  • Skin Tone Correction: Known for its natural brightening properties, Papaya extract helps to diminish the appearance of dark spots, blemishes, and uneven pigmentation for a more uniform look.

  • Vitamin-Rich Formula: Loaded with Vitamins A, C, and E, this cream provides essential nutrients that support skin repair and protect against the visible signs of aging.

  • Intensive Moisture: The rich, buttery base creates a protective seal on the skin, locking in hydration for up to 24 hours and soothing dry, flaky patches.

✨ Performance Benefits:

  • Softens & Smoothes: Instantly transforms rough skin into a velvety-soft texture, making it ideal for daily use on the arms, legs, and torso.

  • Non-Greasy Feel: Formulated to absorb efficiently, leaving your skin with a healthy "satin" finish that feels comfortable and clean.

  • Generous 500ml Size: The large jar ensures you have a long-lasting supply for your daily full-body brightening routine.

  • Tropical Fragrance: Infused with a light, refreshing papaya scent that provides a spa-like experience with every application.

✨ How to Apply for Best Results:

  1. Daily Glow: Apply a generous amount to clean, dry skin every morning and evening.

  2. Focus Areas: Pay extra attention to areas prone to hyperpigmentation or dryness, such as the knees, elbows, and décolletage.

  3. The Absorption Trick: Warm a small amount of cream between your palms before massaging it into the skin to enhance penetration and spreadability.

  4. Sun Safety: Because papaya helps renew skin cells, always follow up with SPF on exposed areas during the day to protect your newly brightened complexion.

products.title: Cosmo Carrot Brightening Body Cream (500ml)
products.description:
Revitalize. Brighten. Glow. Restore your skin’s natural radiance with the Cosmo Carrot Body Cream. This intensive moisturizing treatment combines the deep hydration of a traditional body butter with the skin-toning benefits of Carrot Oil. Rich in Beta-Carotene and essential vitamins, this cream is designed to even out skin tone, improve texture, and leave your body feeling exceptionally soft and luminous.

✨ Why Carrot Oil is a Skincare Powerhouse:

  • Natural Brightening: Carrot oil is naturally rich in Vitamin A and Beta-Carotene, which help to gently brighten the complexion and reduce the appearance of dullness and uneven skin tone.

  • Antioxidant Shield: Packed with Vitamin E, this formula helps protect the skin against environmental stressors and free radicals that can lead to premature aging.

  • Deep Tissue Hydration: The thick, emollient texture provides an immediate moisture surge, repairing the skin barrier and preventing moisture loss throughout the day.

  • Refined Texture: Regular use helps to smooth the skin's surface, making it appear firmer, more supple, and youthful.

✨ Performance Benefits:

  • Tone Correction: Helps to gradually fade the look of dark spots and blemishes, promoting a more uniform and "sun-kissed" skin glow.

products.title: Cosmo Cocoa Butter Hydrating Body Cream (500ml)

Deep Nourishment. Total Radiance. Indulge your skin in the luxurious richness of the Cosmo Cocoa Butter Body Cream.   • Intense 24-Hour Hydration: Engineered for long-lasting moisture, this formula delivers deep hydration that lasts all day, preventing the "tight" or itchy feeling associated with dry skin.

  • Targets Rough Areas: The perfect solution for smoothing out stubborn rough patches on elbows, knees, heels, and knuckles.

  • Generous 500ml Size: Housed in a high-capacity jar that is ideal for daily family use or for those who prioritize a full-body moisturizing routine.

  • Comforting Aroma: Leaves a delicate, warm cocoa scent on the skin that is comforting without being overwhelming.

  • Suitable for All Skin Types: While highly effective for dry and mature skin, its balanced formula is gentle enough for all skin types.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar for Women Rose Gold Eau De Parfum
products.description:

products.title: Maybelline Color Sensational Ultimatte Slim Lipstick
products.description:
Experience "more" with the Maybelline Color Sensational Ultimatte Slim Lipstick. This luxe, slim-bullet lipstick is designed to deliver high-impact color with an extreme matte finish, all while maintaining a weightless, "air-plush" feel.

Infused with Jojoba Oil, it glides on effortlessly, providing a comfortable, non-drying wear that feels as light as a lip balm but looks as bold as a professional pigment.

  1. Start at the Center: Apply the lipstick in the center of your upper lip, following the natural contours of your mouth.

Key Features & Benefits

  • 12-Hour Longwear: A fade-resistant formula that stays vibrant and glowing from morning to night.

  • Glow & Bronze: Multi-use shades that act as a blush, bronzer, and highlighter in one.

Achieving a flawless glow is as easy as 1-2-3:

  1. Dot: Use the plush applicator to apply 2–3 small dots to the apples of your cheeks or along the cheekbones.

  2. Blend: Using your fingers, a beauty sponge, or a buffing brush, blend upward toward the temples for a lifted effect.

  • Pink Mirage: A soft, ethereal pink for a delicate, luminous flush.

products.title: Hummer Fragrance Gift Set (125ml + 18ml)

products.title: Gucci Rouge À Lèvres Matte Lipstick

products.title: Giorgio Armani Luminous Silk Foundation

products.title: Sephora Matte Powder Foundation #03 peach

products.title: Sephora 12H Retractable Eyeliner Pencil #01 Black Matte

products.title: MAC Cosmetics Lip Pencil
products.description:

✨ Why it’s an Industry Icon:

  • Precision Control: Unlike twist-up liners, this traditional wood-clenched pencil can be sharpened to a fine point, making it the best tool for defining the cupid’s bow and correcting lip symmetry.

  • Multi-Purpose Formula: Its velvet-matte texture is versatile enough to be used as a traditional liner, an all-over lip base, or even as a matte lip color on its own.

✨ The Most Iconic M·A·C Shades:

  • Whirl: The legendary dirty-rose shade that defined the "90s nude" lip.

  • Chestnut: The essential deep-brown contour for medium-to-deep skin tones.

  • Ruby Woo: The perfect, vivid-red companion to the world's most famous matte lipstick.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Sharpen for Success: Always start with a freshly sharpened point for the most crisp, professional edge.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Burbon Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Indulgent. Spirited. Sophisticated. Experience the rich, golden evolution of a legend with Lattafa Asad Bourbon. As the latest chapter in the iconic Asad collection, Bourbon moves away from the classic spicy-aromatic DNA and into the world of luxury gourmands. It is a fragrance that balances the tart sweetness of dark fruit with the addictive warmth of cacao and precious resins. This is the scent of a modern gentleman who appreciates the finer things—smooth, bold, and intoxicating.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Mirabelle Plum, Lavender, and Pink Pepper — A unique, mouth-watering opening. The juicy plum provides a dark fruitiness, while the lavender and pepper keep it fresh and sophisticated.

  • Heart Notes: Cacao, Nutmeg, and Davana — An opulent, "chocolatey" heart. The cacao adds a dry, powdery sweetness, while davana provides a mysterious, boozy-herbal depth.

  • Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Amber, and Vetiver — A luxurious, creamy finish. The namesake Bourbon Vanilla creates a rich, velvety trail that is perfectly grounded by earthy vetiver and golden amber.

✨ Why Asad Bourbon is the New Crowd Favorite:

  • The "Gourmand-Fougère" Hybrid: It perfectly blends the clean, groomed feel of a traditional fougère (lavender/pepper) with the addictive, "edible" qualities of cacao and vanilla.

  • Non-Boozy "Bourbon": Despite the name, this fragrance focuses on Bourbon Vanilla (a premium vanilla bean variety) rather than liquor. It is sweet and creamy rather than sharp or alcoholic.

  • A Designer-Quality Dupe: Fans of the line describe this as a sophisticated blend of Azzaro The Most Wanted and Valentino Born in Roma, offering high-end, "date-night" vibes at an incredible value.

  • Superior Longevity: Like the rest of the Asad line, Bourbon is a high-performance EDP, known for 8+ hours of wear and a sillage that feels warm and inviting rather than overwhelming.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Date Night Application: Apply to pulse points—neck and wrists. The cacao and vanilla notes are activated by body heat, creating a sensual, "come-closer" aroma.

  2. Cool Weather Companion: The warmth of the amber and plum makes this an exceptional choice for autumn and winter. It performs beautifully when sprayed on wool coats or scarves.

  3. The "Gourmand" Secret: Apply over a fragrance-free moisturizer. The oils in the cream will help "anchor" the delicate cacao and plum notes, ensuring they stay vibrant from morning until evening.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Elixir Eau de Parfum - Smoky Tobacco & Saffron
products.description:
Dark. Intense. Majestic. Step into a world of refined power with Lattafa Asad Elixir. Building on the legendary success of the original Asad, the Elixir edition is a deeper, more concentrated evolution designed for the modern connoisseur. This "Oriental Woody" fragrance moves away from the purely spicy profile of its predecessor, introducing a smoky, addictive heart of tobacco and smooth vanilla. It is a scent that doesn't just enter a room—it commands it.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Saffron, and Grapefruit — A sharp, luxurious opening. The saffron provides a "leathery" floral touch, while the grapefruit adds a flash of zesty energy.

  • Heart Notes: Tobacco, Cedarwood, and Vanilla — The soul of the Elixir. A rich, smoky tobacco accord is balanced by the creamy sweetness of vanilla, creating a sophisticated "gentleman’s club" vibe.

  • Base Notes: Patchouli, Olibanum (Frankincense), and Cashmeran — A resinous, earthy dry-down that provides incredible depth, warmth, and a velvety smooth trail.

✨ Why Asad Elixir is a Standout:

  • The "Tobacco-Vanilla" Evolution: While the original Asad is famous for its spicy lavender (inspired by Sauvage Elixir), Asad Elixir moves closer to the world of high-end niche perfumery by emphasizing dark woods and tobacco.

  • Beast-Mode Performance: True to the "Elixir" name, this fragrance offers exceptional longevity (10+ hours) and an enormous sillage that performs beautifully in cold weather and during evening events.

  • A New Signature: It strikes a perfect balance between being ruggedly masculine and creamy-sweet, making it a versatile choice for dates, formal gatherings, or as a bold daily signature.

  • Regal Presentation: Housed in the iconic Asad bottle, now reimagined with deeper gold accents to reflect the more precious, concentrated liquid inside.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Pulse Point Precision: Apply to the neck and chest. The warmth of your body will help the Frankincense and Patchouli notes bloom, creating a rich, resinous aura.

  2. The "Maturation" Tip: Like many high-concentration Middle Eastern fragrances, Asad Elixir often becomes even richer after a few weeks of use. If the tobacco note feels sharp at first, let the bottle "rest" for 2–3 weeks to allow the vanilla and woods to fully harmonize.

  3. Evening Layering: This fragrance is a cold-weather champion. Lightly mist your coat or scarf; the cedar and tobacco notes are incredibly persistent on natural fibers and will leave a captivating trail as you move.

products.title: Retinol & Collagen Age Solution Face Cream
products.description:
Renew. Firm. Hydrate. Experience the ultimate all-in-one transformation with our Retinol & Collagen Age Solution Cream. This high-performance moisturizer is engineered for both men and women who want professional results without a 10-step routine. By blending the resurfacing power of Retinol with the structural support of Collagen and the deep hydration of Hyaluronic Acid, this cream targets fine lines, loss of elasticity, and uneven texture simultaneously.

✨ The Triple-Action Powerhouse:

  • Retinol (Vitamin A): The gold standard in anti-aging. It works at a cellular level to speed up skin renewal, visibly reducing the appearance of deep wrinkles, age spots, and enlarged pores.

  • Collagen: Provides the essential "scaffolding" your skin needs. It helps improve the look of skin firmness and bounce, giving the face and neck a more lifted, youthful contour.

  • Hyaluronic Acid: A moisture magnet that holds up to 1,000 times its weight in water. It instantly plumps the skin, smoothing out "crepy" textures and providing a dewy, healthy glow.

✨ Why it’s the Perfect "Age Solution":

  • Day & Night Versatility: Formulated to be lightweight enough for daytime wear under SPF and makeup, yet rich enough to deeply nourish and repair the skin while you sleep.

  • Non-Greasy "Airless" Tech: Often featuring an airless pump to maintain ingredient potency, the texture is silky and fast-absorbing, leaving a shine-free finish that works for all skin types (oily, dry, and combination).

  • Universal Formula: Designed with soothing botanicals like Aloe Vera and Vitamin E to balance the potency of Retinol, making it gentle enough for those new to anti-aging actives.

  • 1.85 Oz Value Size: A generous amount of product compared to standard 1.7 oz jars, ensuring you have enough to cover the face, neck, and décolleté—the three areas that show age first.

✨ How to Apply for Best Results:

  1. Cleanse & Prep: Apply to a clean, slightly damp face and neck.

  2. Upward Motion: Massage a dime-sized amount into the skin using upward, circular motions. This helps "lift" the skin while improving blood circulation for better absorption.

  3. Sun Protection: Because Retinol makes the skin more sensitive to the sun, always follow with a broad-spectrum SPF 30+ during the day to protect your results.

products.title: Givenchy Live Irresistible Eau de Toilette

While the EDP version is deep and gourmand, the Eau de Toilette is airier and more zesty, blending Mediterranean citrus with a surprising spicy kick. It is a scent that feels like a burst of laughter on a sunny Parisian afternoon.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Pear, Raspberry, and Pink Pepper — A mouth-watering, zesty opening that is instantly bright, tart, and energizing with a hint of spicy heat.

  • Heart Notes: Rose and Berry Sorbet — A "chilled" floral heart. The dew-covered rose is refreshed by a sweet, icy berry accord for a playful, youthful texture.

  • Base Notes: Musk and Blond Woods — A clean, airy dry-down that provides a soft, "second-skin" finish and a lingering sense of freshness.

✨ Why the EDT is a Summer Essential:

  • The "Iced" Berry Effect: The inclusion of a sorbet-like berry note makes this version feel "cool" on the skin, making it the perfect choice for high-heat days and outdoor events.

  • Daily Optimism: This is widely considered the ultimate "mood-booster" fragrance. It is bright enough for the office, playful enough for a brunch date, and light enough for the gym.

  • Faceted Glass Design: Housed in a slender, multi-faceted bottle that captures and reflects light, it is as shimmering and multi-dimensional as the scent itself.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Morning Refresh: Apply to pulse points—wrists, neck, and inner elbows—immediately after a cool shower for an instant boost of energy.

  2. The "Scent Cloud": For a delicate, all-over aura that stays fresh in the heat, spray a cloud in front of you and walk through it just before leaving the house.

  3. Summer Layering: Apply to well-hydrated skin. Using a citrus or berry-based moisturizer beforehand will help the pear and rose notes stay vibrant for 6–8 hours.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Boisee Eau de Parfum

  • Day-to-Night Versatility: While it is deep and woody, the spicy top notes and geranium keep it refined enough for a professional office setting during the day, while the smoky base dominates the evening.

  3. Winter Essential: The smoky, balsamic base notes of Boisée perform exceptionally well in cold weather. Lightly mist your favorite wool sweater or scarf for a scent that lingers for days.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Sea Rose for Women Eau de Toilette

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water for Women Eau de Toilette

products.title: Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser 500ml – Hydrating Face & Body Wash for Sensitive Skin
products.description:
For over 70 years, Cetaphil has been the go-to brand for those with sensitive skin. The Gentle Skin Cleanser remains their most iconic product, designed to provide effective cleansing while maintaining the skin's moisture barrier.

What Makes It Different?

  • Micellar Technology: It acts like a magnet to lift away dirt and oil without the need for harsh scrubbing or foaming agents that can irritate the skin.

  • The "5 Signs" Defense: This cleanser is specifically designed to combat dryness, irritation, roughness, tightness, and a weakened skin barrier.

  • Versatile Cleansing: It is one of the few cleansers that can be used with water for a traditional wash or without water (applied and wiped off with a cotton pad) for ultra-sensitive or post-procedure skin.

  • Safe for the Whole Family: Because it is hypoallergenic and non-comedogenic (won't clog pores), it is safe for everyone from teenagers to adults.

Pro-Tip for Best Results:

Apply a small amount to damp or dry skin. Massage gently in circular motions. If using water, rinse and pat dry. If using without water, simply wipe away the excess with a soft cloth or tissue, leaving a thin transparent film that keeps the skin hydrated.

products.title: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Coral Fantasy – Eau de Toilette
products.description:

The Scent Journey:

  • The Opening: Unlike the mineral salt of the original, Coral Fantasy begins with a bold, fruity burst of Red Apple and spicy Cardamom, creating an instant "wow" factor.

  • The Heart: The fragrance maintains its masculine roots with Clary Sage and Geranium, providing a sophisticated, aromatic bridge.

  • The Dry Down: The scent evolves into a warm, lingering finish. The addition of Tobacco gives it a smoky, rich depth that makes it a perfect choice for evening wear or cooler weather.

The Rockstud Legacy: The bottle features the legendary Valentino Rockstud. This pyramid-shaped design, inspired by the walls of Rome's palazzos, is a house signature. The coral liquid inside creates a stunning visual contrast against the black hardware, making it a true collector's piece for your vanity.

products.title: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo For Him – Eau de Toilette
products.description:

  • Heart Notes: As the scent settles, a heart of aromatic Clary Sage adds a layer of herbal, sophisticated masculinity that remains clean throughout the day.

  • Base Notes: The dry down is where the "smoke" happens. Smoked Vetiver and woody notes create a powerful, masculine trail that lingers on the skin, making it a perfect signature scent.

  • The Multitasker: This liner is pigmented enough to be worn alone. Many users apply it all over the lips and top it with a clear gloss for a quick, long-lasting daytime look.

products.description:
Why settle for just removing makeup when you can improve your skin at the same time? Garnier’s Micellar Gentle Peeling Water is designed for those who want the benefits of a chemical exfoliant without the irritation of a traditional "peel."

The Power Ingredients:

  • Glycolic Acid (AHA): Known as the gold standard in exfoliation, it dives deep to unstick dead skin cells that cause dullness.

  • 1% PHA (Polyhydroxy Acid): The "gentle sister" of AHA. It exfoliates the surface while acting as a humectant to keep moisture locked in.

  • Papaya Extract: A natural enzyme that helps brighten skin tone and refine texture.

Why the 400ml Bottle? This value-sized bottle is perfect for daily use. Because the formula is balanced for sensitive skin, you can incorporate it into your nightly routine to keep your pores clear of pollution, SPF, and makeup residue.

How to get the best results: Saturate a cotton pad (reusable pads work great with this formula!). Press it against your skin for a few seconds to let the micelles "grab" the makeup, then swipe away. Because of the active acids, do not forget to apply SPF the following morning, as exfoliation makes your fresh skin more sensitive to the sun!

products.description:

By using color-canceling pigments, these pens allow you to use less makeup while achieving a much more natural, "filter-like" finish.

  • Targeted Precision: The unique "micro-point" felt tip allows you to apply color only where you need it—no messy fingers or bulky brushes required.

It doesn't just sit on top of your makeup; it works with it to control sebum and keep you looking "just-applied" fresh.

Why It’s a Game Changer:

  • Temperature Control Tech: This is the cool part (literally). It actually lowers the temperature of your makeup to keep it from smudging or melting, even when you're in a hot office or out on a humid night.

  • Oil-Absorbing Power: It features light-dispersing particles that deflect shine and absorb excess oil throughout the day.

  • Micro-Fine Mist: No "big droplets" here. The sprayer delivers a mist so fine you’ll barely feel it, ensuring your makeup stays smooth and even—never splotchy.

It helps prevent smudging, fading, creasing, and oil or sweat interference, keeping your makeup looking fresh for hours. Setting sprays can also provide finishes like matte, natural, or dewy depending on the formula.

All Nighter Setting Spray vs All Nighter Vitamin C Version

  • Original All Nighter Setting Spray:

    • Focuses purely on long-lasting hold.

    • Keeps makeup in place for up to 24 hours.

    • Provides a natural finish without altering skin tone.

    • Ideal for durability, resisting heat, humidity, and sweat.

  • All Nighter Setting Spray with Vitamin C:

    • Provides the same long-lasting hold as the original.

    • Infused with Vitamin C, which helps brighten and refresh the skin.

✨ Why It’s a Cult Classic:

  • The "Sugared Almond" Signature: Unlike many sugary perfumes that can feel youthful, Burberry Brit uses a refined almond note that is creamy, toasted, and high-end.

  • The Perfect "Season-Crosser": The lime and pear keep it fresh enough for a rainy spring day, while the vanilla and mahogany provide the warmth needed for a cold winter evening.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  • Heart Notes: Patchouli and Lavender — A rich, earthy heart that balances traditional masculine florals with a deep, resinous texture.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Evening Application: Apply to pulse points like the neck and wrists. The cinnamon and amber notes respond beautifully to body heat, creating a magnetic "bubble" of scent.

Aura Fragrance Ameer Black – Eau de Parfum

Command Respect. Exude Confidence.

Aura Fragrance Ameer Black is a bold, luxurious scent crafted for the modern leader. Opening with a mysterious blend of spicy saffron and smoky oud, it unfolds into a rich heart of leather and dark woods. The base lingers with warm amber and musky undertones, leaving a powerful, lasting impression.

Perfect for evening wear or special occasions, Ameer Black is more than a fragrance—it's a signature of strength, sophistication, and charisma.

  • Top Notes: Saffron, Oud

  • Heart Notes: Leather, Cedarwood

products.title: Aura Fragrances Ameer Blue Edition EDP 100ml
products.description:
Vitality. Sophistication. Confidence. Discover the enchanting blend of freshness and depth with Ameer Blue Edition by Aura Fragrances. This meticulously crafted Eau de Parfum is designed for the modern man who moves with effortless charisma. Ameer Blue Edition strikes the perfect balance between invigorating top notes and a warm, commanding base, making it an essential signature scent for daily wear, professional settings, or sophisticated evening occasions.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Refreshing Mint, Crisp Green Apple, and Zesty Lemon — A vibrant, energetic opening that immediately awakens the senses with sparkling freshness.

  • Heart Notes: Warm Tonka Bean, Golden Amber, and Aromatic Geranium — A sophisticated heart that adds depth, sweetness, and a touch of refined masculinity.

  • Base Notes: Creamy Vanilla, Earthy Cedarwood, and Moss — A rich, velvety finish that provides lasting comfort and a seductive, enduring trail.

✨ Why It’s a Standout:

  • Versatile Modern Masculinity: A perfectly balanced composition that bridges crisp freshness with warm depth, making it ideal for year-round wear.

  • High-Quality Craftsmanship: Features a masterfully blended formula that ensures longevity and moderate, charismatic projection.

  • Symbol of Confidence: Designed to enhance the presence of the man who appreciates understated elegance and timeless appeal.

  • Stunning Blue Bottle: The sleek, deep blue bottle reflects the serene yet commanding nature of the fragrance within.

✨ Scent Experience:

  • Vibe: Charismatic, energetic, sophisticated, and refreshing.

  • Season: A versatile scent that thrives in Spring and Summer for its freshness, yet has enough depth to be worn comfortably in Autumn.

💡 Pro-Tip for Best Results:

To experience the full evolution of the scent, apply Ameer Blue Edition to pulse points—wrists, neck, and behind the ears—after showering. For a longer-lasting effect that retains its crisp opening, spray lightly on clothing, where the woody and vanilla notes will hold strength throughout the day.

Product Specifications:

  • Brand: Aura Fragrances

  • Product Type: Eau de Parfum (EDP)

  • Size: 100ml / 3.4 fl. oz.

  • Gender: Men

products.title: Burberry Hero for Men Parfum
products.description:
Powerful. Intense. Magnetic. Discover a new chapter of modern masculinity with Burberry Hero Parfum. Launched in 2024 as the most concentrated addition to the Hero collection, this Parfum is a bold transformation of the original DNA. It is a fragrance designed for the man who is on a journey of self-discovery—intense, adventurous, and deeply connected to the natural world. Housed in a deep oak-colored bottle with gold accents, it represents the pinnacle of Burberry’s rugged elegance.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Amyris — A warm, resinous, and slightly balsamic opening that provides a rich, "creamy-wood" first impression.

  • Heart Notes: Cypriol Oil (Nagarmotha) — An earthy, spicy, and woody heart that adds a smoky, sophisticated edge.

  • Base Notes: Signature Cedarwood Trio (Atlas, Virginian, and Himalayan) — The backbone of the Hero line, intensified here to provide a dark, syrupy, and long-lasting woody foundation.

✨ Why the Parfum is the "Alpha" of the Line:

  • Maximum Concentration: As a Parfum, this version contains the highest percentage of fragrance oils, offering "beast-mode" performance with a rich, thick texture that sits beautifully on the skin.

  • The "Dark" Hero: While the EDT is fresh and the EDP is resinous, the Parfum is noticeably darker and more syrupy. It’s a "winter-warmer" scent that cuts through the cold with ease.

  • Unbeatable Longevity: Engineered for the man who needs his fragrance to last 10+ hours. A few sprays in the morning provide a deep, masculine aura that stays vibrant well into the evening.

  • Sophisticated Sillage: It creates a powerful, sophisticated trail (sillage) that is perfect for outdoor events, cold-weather styling, or making a lasting impression on a night out.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Less is More: Due to its extreme concentration, start with 2–3 sprays on your pulse points (neck and wrists). This is a high-impact fragrance.

  2. Cold Weather Performance: This scent blooms exceptionally well on wool coats, scarves, and heavy knits. The cypriol and cedarwood notes cling to natural fibers for days.

  3. Evening Layering: For a truly multi-dimensional experience, use a fragrance-free body wash before applying, allowing the "creamy" amyris notes to take center stage.

products.title: All Eau de Toilette
products.description:
Fresh, bold, and universally appealing, CK All Eau de Toilette by Calvin Klein is a modern unisex fragrance that redefines individuality. Designed to celebrate freedom of expression, this crisp citrus scent opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin, and grapefruit blossom. At its heart, vibrant floral notes blend with clean, green accords, while a soft, warm base of amber and musk provides a smooth, lasting finish.

Perfect for daily wear, CK All is a clean, refreshing scent that suits anyone and everyone.

Key Notes:

  • Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Grapefruit Blossom

  • Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rhubarb, Freesia, Lily

  • Base Notes: Amber, Musk, Vetiver

Why You’ll Love It:

  • Gender-neutral fragrance for all

  • Clean and refreshing, perfect for any season

  • Long-lasting and versatile

products.title: Eternity Flame Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Discover the passionate side of timeless elegance with Calvin Klein Eternity Flame for Women. This warm and captivating Eau de Parfum reimagines the classic Eternity signature with a glowing intensity. The fragrance opens with a radiant burst of mandarin, unfolding into a heart of delicate sweet pea, and settles into a sensual amber base. Bold yet graceful, Eternity Flame celebrates modern femininity with a fiery spirit that leaves a lasting impression.

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top: Mandarin Orange

  • Heart: Sweet Pea

products.title: Light Blue Eau Intense
products.description:
Fragrance Family:
Fresh

Fresh Floral

Lemon, Jasmine Petals, Musk

Overview:
Sixteen years after introducing the iconic Light Blue, master perfumer Olivier Cresp unveils a new chapter in the saga—Light Blue Eau Intense pour Femme. This fragrance begins with an invigorating blend of zesty lemon and crisp Granny Smith apple. The heart unfolds into a radiant floral bouquet where elegant marigold harmonizes with the rich, luminous essence of jasmine petals. The scent lingers with a captivating base of warm amber woods and soft musk, creating a sensuous, sun-drenched trail on the skin.

The flacon’s sleek, contemporary design mirrors the fragrance’s enhanced intensity. Housed in frosted glass, the bottle captures the iconic light blue hue inspired by the sparkling Mediterranean Sea.

products.title: Women Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Discover CK Women Eau De Parfum, a captivating fragrance designed for the modern, confident woman. This elegant scent blends freshness, sensuality, and sophistication, creating an unforgettable signature you’ll love to wear every day.

Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Fresh eucalyptus and bright citrus

  • Heart Notes: Orange blossom and delicate floral accords

  • Base Notes: Warm cedarwood and earthy undertones

Crafted to inspire empowerment and individuality, CK Women EDP delivers a clean yet luxurious aroma that lasts throughout the day. Perfect for both daytime wear and evening occasions, this perfume speaks to women who embrace authenticity and self-expression.

products.title: Euphoria Blush Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Notes


Experience a fragrance that captures the essence of elegance and sophistication with Calvin Klein's My Euphoria. Launched in 2023, this exquisite scent is designed specifically for ladies who seek a touch of luxury in their everyday lives.

Belonging to the Amber Floral fragrance family, My Euphoria opens with a burst of black currant, creating a fresh and inviting top note. As the scent unfolds, heart notes of sesame, orchid, and tuberose add a rich and captivating floral dimension. The fragrance is rounded out with a warm and earthy base of sandalwood, agarwood (oud), and bamboo, leaving a lasting impression that is both unique and memorable.

products.title: Eau Sauvage Eau de Toilette
products.description:
Dior Eau Sauvage Eau de Toilette is an iconic men’s fragrance that redefined masculine elegance when it launched in 1966. Timeless and sophisticated, this classic scent is celebrated for its crisp citrus opening, subtle floral heart, and refined chypre base. It is a fresh yet complex composition that has stood the test of time, perfect for the modern gentleman who values tradition and style.

Crafted by perfumer Edmond Roudnitska, Eau Sauvage is the first fragrance to use Hedione, a jasmine-like molecule that adds a radiant floral lift and sensual freshness. The result is a balanced scent that’s invigorating yet smooth, making it ideal for daily wear, especially in spring and summer.

Fragrance Notes

  • Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Lemon, Rosemary, Basil

  • Heart Notes: Hedione, Jasmine, Coriander, Carnation, Orris Root

  • Base Notes: Oakmoss, Vetiver, Patchouli, Musk, Amber

products.title: Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette
products.description:
Dior Sauvage Eau de Toilette is a bold and refreshing fragrance inspired by wide-open landscapes and rugged wilderness. With an intoxicating blend of spicy freshness and masculine depth, this scent opens with zesty Calabrian bergamot, electrified by Sichuan pepper and grounded by the earthy richness of Ambroxan. Crafted by François Demachy, Dior’s master perfumer, Sauvage is a raw yet refined composition that evokes strength, freedom, and timeless sophistication. Ideal for day or night wear, this fragrance leaves a lasting impression wherever you go.

  • Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot

  • Heart Notes: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender

  • Base Notes: Ambroxan, Cedar

  • Refillable: Yes (select sizes)

  • Fragrance Family: Fresh, Woody, Spicy

  • Best For: Men, All Seasons

products.title: Dior Sauvage Parfum
products.description:
Dior Sauvage Parfum is a powerful and refined men’s fragrance that delivers a deeper, richer twist on the iconic Sauvage scent. Designed for the modern man who commands attention, this parfum blends fresh citrus with warm oriental notes for a bold, long-lasting impression.

Opening with juicy Calabrian bergamot and spicy mandarin, Sauvage Parfum quickly reveals its heart of Sri Lankan sandalwood, offering creamy, smoky warmth. The dry-down features vanilla absolute and tonka bean, adding an ambery sensuality that lingers on the skin.

Crafted by Dior’s legendary perfumer François Demachy, Sauvage Parfum is inspired by the rugged beauty of nature at twilight — raw, powerful, and mysteriously elegant. Ideal for evening wear and special occasions.

Fragrance Profile

  • Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Mandarin

  • Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean

  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Olibanum

products.title: Floral Eau De Parfum
products.description:
🌸 Product Description – Coach Floral Eau de Parfum

Coach Floral Eau de Parfum is a radiant, modern floral fragrance that captures the free-spirited elegance of the Coach woman. Inspired by the iconic Tea Rose motif, this fresh and feminine scent opens with a sparkling burst of citrus and pink peppercorn, gracefully unfolding into a heart of lush rose and gardenia. The warm, sensual base of creamy woods and musk leaves a lasting impression of effortless sophistication.

Perfect for everyday wear or special occasions, Coach Floral is a delicate yet confident fragrance that adds a touch of charm and freshness to every moment. Housed in a beautifully designed bottle adorned with the signature leather tag and Tea Rose charm, this perfume is as elegant on the outside as it is enchanting within.

💐 Key Fragrance Notes

  • Top Notes: Pineapple, Pink Pepper, Orange, Bergamot

  • Heart Notes: Tea Rose, Jasmine Sambac, Gardenia

  • Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk, Vanilla, Sandalwood

products.title: Coach Wild Rose Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Free-Spirited. Romantic. Bold. Embark on an adventure through a sun-drenched meadow with Coach Wild Rose. Inspired by the untamed beauty of wildflowers and the optimistic spirit of the American West, this fragrance is a vibrant tribute to modern femininity. It is a scent of "endless possibilities"—delicate enough for a spring morning, yet bold enough to leave a lasting impression.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Redcurrant and Bergamot — A sparkling, juicy opening that offers a tart, refreshing energy.

  • Heart Notes: Wild Rose and Jasmine Sambac — A lush, floral heart that feels like a bouquet of freshly picked blooms in an open field.

  • Base Notes: Crystal Moss and Dusky Ambroxan — A warm, woody dry-down that provides a sophisticated, modern earthiness.

✨ Why It’s a Standout:

  • The "Wild" Rose Accord: Unlike traditional, powdery rose perfumes, this "Wild Rose" version is jammy and bright, leaning into a Floral Fruity profile that feels youthful and energized.

  • Modern Sensuality: The use of Ambroxan and Moss in the base gives the fragrance a sleek, "clean-skin" finish that grounds the sweetness of the berries and florals.

  • The Signature Design: Featuring a stunning burgundy ombré gradient, the bottle is finished with the iconic Coach hangtag and a "turnlock" spray cap—a tribute to the brand's heritage in luxury leather craftsmanship.

✨ Scent Experience:

  • Vibe: Effortlessly cool, romantic, and adventurous.

  • Occasion: An incredibly versatile "signature scent." It is light and fresh enough for the office or daytime errands, but the warm base makes it sultry enough for a sunset dinner.

products.title: Coach Platinum Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Bold. Magnetic. Adventurous. Inspired by the spirit of the open road and the freedom of a cross-country journey, Coach Platinum is a warm, sensual fragrance for the modern adventurer. This Eau de Parfum is a "fresh oriental" masterpiece—shifting away from typical citrus scents to offer something deeper, creamier, and more charismatic.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Pineapple, Black Pepper, and Juniper Berries — A vibrant, "fizzy" opening that balances tropical sweetness with a sharp, peppery kick.

  • Heart Notes: Cashmeran, Clary Sage, and Geranium — A refined, aromatic heart that introduces a velvety, "cashmere-like" texture.

  • Base Notes: Vanilla Leather, Sandalwood, Patchouli, and Musk — A rich, seductive dry-down that provides a smooth, "creamy" masculine finish.

✨ Why It’s a Standout:

  • The "Smooth" Alternative: Often celebrated for being more refined and less aggressive than standard fresh scents, Coach Platinum is an excellent choice for both the office and close-encounter settings.

  • Unique Pineapple & Leather Duo: The combination of juicy pineapple and sophisticated leather creates a distinctive scent trail that is both mass-appealing and uniquely memorable.

  • Iconic Design: The bottle is wrapped in a luminous, mirrored silver lacquer. It features the signature Coach "turnlock" spray cap and a leather hangtag, embodying the brand’s luxury craftsmanship.

✨ Scent Experience:

  • Vibe: Confident, refined, and polished.

  • Occasion: Exceptionally versatile. While it has the depth for Autumn and Winter evenings, the pineapple top note provides enough brightness for Spring and Fall daytime wear.

products.title: Coach Open Road for Men Eau de Toilette
products.description:
Crisp. Energizing. Spontaneous. Feel the wind in your face and the freedom of the horizon with Coach Open Road. Inspired by a road trip along the American coast and the thrill of adventure with friends, this fragrance is a "Woody Aromatic" masterpiece. It is the scent of a moment caught in time—dynamic, refreshing, and full of optimistic energy.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Juicy Red Apple and Sparkling Lemon — A sharp, crunchy, and ultra-fresh opening that wakes up the senses.

  • Heart Notes: Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, and Clary Sage — A spicy, aromatic heart that adds a modern "blue" grit and a clean, herbal coolness.

  • Base Notes: Vetiver, Cedarwood, and Patchouli — A solid, earthy dry-down that provides a grounded, woody finish reminiscent of the great outdoors.

✨ Why It’s a Standout:

  • The "Grey" Fragrance: While many modern men's scents fall into the "Blue" category, Open Road is often described as a "Grey" scent—balancing the brightness of citrus with the rugged, mineral earthiness of the road.

  • Exceptional Freshness: The red apple note is remarkably realistic, giving the fragrance a crispness that stays vibrant even as the spicy pepper and sage begin to develop.

  • Modern Craftsmanship: The bottle features a transparent glass design with a grey-blue tint, finished with the iconic Coach "turnlock" spray cap and a luxury engraved base.

✨ Scent Experience:

    • Vibe: Casual, athletic, and effortlessly cool.

    • Occasion: The perfect "everyday" fragrance. Its light, airy profile makes it an ideal choice for the gym, the office, or weekend trips during Spring and Summer.

products.title: Pour Homme Eau De Toilette
products.description:
Discover the elegance of Versace Pour Homme, a sophisticated fragrance tailored for the contemporary man. Introduced in 2008, this aromatic fougère composition fuses zesty citrus, rich woods, and sensual musk, offering a bold yet refined olfactory experience. Created by the iconic Italian fashion house Versace, it captures the essence of confidence, timeless masculinity, and effortless style.

Fragrance Notes :

  • Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Lavender

  • Heart Notes: Sage, Jasmine, Geranium

  • Base Notes: Cedarwood, Amber, Musk, Tonka Bean

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana K (King) Eau de Toilette for Men
products.description:
A Fragrance for the Modern King. Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Toilette is a Mediterranean journey that opens with a refreshing, zesty duo of Sicilian Lemon and Sparkling Blood Orange. This vibrant opening is balanced by a heart of unexpected spice—the heat of Pimento Pepper—which gives the fragrance a unique, energetic personality.

As the scent evolves, it anchors into a deep, masculine base of Cedarwood, Vetiver, and Patchouli. The result is a woody, aromatic masterpiece that is both fresh and grounding. Whether for a day in the office or a night out, D&G King is designed for the man who is the master of his own destiny.

👃 Fragrance Notes:

  • Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Blood Orange, Juniper Berries, and Citruses.

  • Heart Notes: Pimento (Chili Pepper), Clary Sage, Geranium, and Lavender.

  • Base Notes: Cedarwood, Vetiver, and Patchouli.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana K (King) Eau de Parfum Intense for Men
products.description:
A bold new chapter in masculinity. Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum Intense is an invitation to explore the more mysterious and soulful side of the modern King. This fragrance maintains the iconic citrus DNA but transforms it into a richer, more hypnotic experience by adding exotic spices and deep, carnal base notes.

The scent opens with the familiar spark of Sicilian Lemon and Blood Orange, but it is immediately met by the warmth of Saffron, known as "Red Gold." This spiciness flows into a creamy Fig heart, eventually settling into a commanding Leather and Wood base that projects confidence and longevity.

👃 Fragrance Notes:

  • Top Notes: Sicilian Lemon, Blood Orange, and Spicy Saffron.

  • Heart Notes: Fig Accord, Lavender, and Geranium.

  • Base Notes: Deep Leather, Cedarwood, and Earthy Patchouli.

🌟 Why It Stands Out:

  • Unmatched Longevity: Being an Intense concentration, this fragrance is designed to last 8+ hours on the skin.

  • Modern Masculinity: The addition of leather makes this the "darkest" and most mature version of the King collection.

  • Majestic Bottle: The glass is dressed in a deeper, midnight-blue gradient, topped with the signature burnished silver crown

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Seductive. Mysterious. Creamy. Step into a world of pure Italian glamour with Versace Crystal Noir. Often described as a "femme fatale" fragrance, this Eau De Parfum is a masterpiece of contrast—blending sharp, exotic spices with a velvet-soft floral heart. It is the scent of a midnight garden, designed for the woman who is confident, effortless, and leaves a lingering trail of intrigue wherever she goes.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Black Pepper, Ginger, and Cardamom — A warm, vibrant opening that provides a sophisticated "slow-burn" spice.

  • Heart Notes: Gardenia, Coconut, and Orange Blossom — The star of the show. A lush, creamy white floral heart with a tropical, skin-like sweetness that feels like high-end sun-kissed skin.

  • Base Notes: Sandalwood, Musk, and Amber — A deep, woody dry-down that provides a smooth, "second-skin" warmth and remarkable staying power.

✨ Why the Eau De Parfum (EDP) Stands Out:

  • Enhanced Creaminess: While the EDT is known for being slightly spicier and sharper, the Eau De Parfum version is prized for its smoother, more "lactonic" coconut and gardenia blend.

  • Superior Longevity: As a higher concentration formula, the EDP is engineered to last through the evening and well into the night, making it the ultimate choice for date nights or formal events.

  • The "Luxe Lotion" Vibe: Crystal Noir is famous for smelling like the world’s most expensive body cream—clean, sophisticated, and deeply sensual.

  • Iconic Bottle Design: Housed in a heavy, jewel-like glass bottle topped with a massive "noir" crystal cap, it serves as a stunning piece of art for any vanity.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Evening Application: Apply to pulse points like the neck, décolletage, and behind the knees for a scent that "blooms" with your body heat.

  2. Layering Secret: Spray onto damp skin after using a coconut or sandalwood-based body oil to amplify the creamy middle notes.

  3. Hair Mist: For a captivating scent trail (sillage), lightly mist your hair or a silk scarf.

products.title: Eros Pour Femme Eau De Toilette
products.description:
Notes

Versace Eros Pour Femme – The Essence of Passion and Power
Enter a world of irresistible allure with Versace Eros Pour Femme, a radiant and seductive fragrance that captures the primal power of femininity. Launched in 2016, this captivating scent is a modern legend from the house of Versace—where desire meets strength, and sensuality becomes a statement.

A Scent of Seduction and Strength
Inspired by the myth of Eros, the God of love, this fragrance tells the story of an encounter between divine passion and feminine power. But in this tale, who seduces whom? Bold and unapologetic, Eros Pour Femme invites you to embrace your desires and command the energy of life itself.

A Mesmerizing Olfactory Symphony
The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Sicilian lemon, Calabrian bergamot, and juicy pomegranate—bright and tantalizing. At its heart, a floral fusion of lemon blossom, jasmine sambac, jasmine infusion, and peony brings a refined elegance and romantic intensity. Finally, a warm, sensual base of sandalwood, ambrox, musk, and soft woods leaves a lingering trail that’s both powerful and unforgettable.

More Than a Perfume—A Declaration
Envisioned by Donatella Versace, Eros Pour Femme is a bold expression of individuality, confidence, and feminine allure. It’s not just a fragrance—it’s Eros, bottled.

products.title: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Unforgettable. Sensual. Elegant. Celebrate the strength and femininity of the modern woman with Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue. Created as a tribute to femininity, this Eau De Parfum is a strong, sensuous, yet refined fragrance that balances refreshing fruitiness with a deep, woody soul. It is a "blue" fragrance reimagined for women—cool, deep, and sophisticated—housed in a bottle inspired by ancient Greek culture and the Mediterranean Sea.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Blackcurrant Sorbet, Granny Smith Apple, Clover, Forget-Me-Not, and Shisolia — A unique, icy-fruit opening that is vibrant, crisp, and incredibly refreshing.

  • Heart Notes: Eglantine Rose, Petalia, Rosyfolia, Jasmine, and Peach — A modern floral heart that feels "fleshy" and lush, blending velvety rose with succulent peach.

  • Base Notes: Styrax, White Woods, Musk, and Patchouli — A smooth, woody dry-down that provides a clean, earthy warmth and exceptional longevity.

✨ Why It’s a Luxury Essential:

  • The "Blackcurrant Sorbet" Effect: Unlike traditional fruity perfumes, Dylan Blue uses a "sorbet" accord that gives it an icy, high-definition crispness that lasts well beyond the initial spray.

  • High Sillage & Longevity: As a concentrated Eau De Parfum, it is known for its incredible "trail" (sillage). It’s a fragrance that gets noticed and stays vibrant from morning until evening.

  • Versatile Glamour: While it has the "kick" for a night out, its clean, soapy-floral dry down makes it surprisingly wearable for a high-powered office environment or a formal daytime event.

  • The Amphora Bottle: The gold-detailed, deep blue bottle is shaped like a Mediterranean amphora, topped with the iconic Versace Medusa—a true collector’s piece for any vanity.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Pulse Point Strategy: Apply to the pulse points—wrists, neck, and behind the ears—where the skin is warmest to help the "sorbet" notes diffuse beautifully.

  2. Mist & Walk: For a more subtle, all-over aura, spray a cloud in the air and walk through it, allowing the fine mist to settle on your hair and clothes.

  3. Hydrated Base: To maximize the woody base notes, apply immediately after a shower while your skin is still slightly damp.

products.title: Versense Eau De Toilette
products.description:
Notes

Versace Versense – A Breath of Mediterranean Elegance
Step into a world of freshness and allure with Versace Versense, a luminous fragrance for women from the iconic house of Versace. Launched in 2009, this Eau de Toilette is a radiant blend of citrus, floral, and woody notes—crafted to reflect the vibrant spirit and sensuality of the woman who wears it.

A Scent Journey Inspired by Nature
The fragrance opens with a sparkling medley of bergamot, green mandarin, fig, citruses, and pear—evoking the refreshing essence of a Mediterranean orchard. At its heart, a graceful bouquet of sea lily, jasmine, narcissus, and a hint of cardamom brings floral elegance and a touch of spice, reminiscent of a serene coastal evening.

A Lasting Impression of Warmth and Sophistication
Sandalwood, cedar, olive wood, and musk form a smooth and earthy base, wrapping the scent in sensual warmth and leaving a lingering, memorable trail.

Effortlessly Chic, Uniquely You
Presented in a 3.3 oz EDT spray, Versense is versatile enough for daily wear yet refined for special moments. It’s more than a fragrance—it’s a reflection of confidence, charm, and individuality.

products.title: Myslf LE PARFUM
products.description:
Notes

Myslf Le Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent – A Bold Expression of Modern Masculinity
Unveil a new dimension of refined strength with Myslf Le Parfum, the 2024 fragrance release from Yves Saint Laurent. Belonging to the Amber Woody family, this Eau de Parfum is a masterful blend of elegance, intensity, and style—crafted for the man who leads with presence.

A Captivating Olfactory Journey
The fragrance opens with a striking note of black pepper, delivering a sharp, invigorating kick that commands attention. At its heart, the delicate allure of orange blossom introduces a soft yet sophisticated warmth. The base unfolds into a deep, lasting trail of patchouli, amber, bourbon vanilla, and rich woods—creating a powerful and unforgettable signature.

The Essence of Sophistication
Myslf Le Parfum isn’t just a fragrance—it’s a personal statement. With its bold contrasts and smooth refinement, it captures the essence of modern manhood in every spray.

products.title: Homme Intense  Eau De Parfum
products.description:
Dior Homme Intense — Refined Power, Unmistakable Presence
Dior Homme Intense embodies noble sophistication and bold sensuality in a powerful Eau de Parfum. Striking a balance between distinction and depth, this woody ambery fragrance leaves a lasting impression of confident elegance.

A Composition of Depth and Character
The scent opens with a refined touch of lavender, leading into a heart of sensual iris, ambrette seed from Ecuador, and juicy pear—blending musky, floral, and subtly fruity nuances. At its base, vetiver and Virginia cedar provide structure and warmth, enveloping the fragrance in a rich, dry woodiness that lingers with understated masculinity.

A Signature of Modern Elegance
With its full, rounded notes and dry, persistent trail, Dior Homme Intense is a distinctly masculine scent—sensual, sophisticated, and unapologetically bold. It’s a true statement of style and confidence for the modern man.

products.title: Parfum d'Eau Perfume
products.description:
Notes

products.title: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum
products.description:
Radiant. Playful. Irresistible. Embrace the power of spontaneity with Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum. This fragrance is an invitation to let go and reveal who you truly are. A "Floral-Woody-Fruity" masterpiece, it balances the contrast between a luscious, luscious rose and a radiant blond wood. It is a scent for the woman who is naturally magnetic, combining a flirtatious sweetness with a sophisticated, high-fashion edge.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Sparkling Pear and Ambrette — A juicy, mouth-watering opening that is instantly bright and slightly musky, providing a sophisticated "skin-like" fruitiness.

  • Heart Notes: Luscious Rose Essential and Iris — A "beaming" floral heart. The rose is fresh and dewy, while the iris adds a clean, powdery elegance that feels incredibly chic.

  • Base Notes: Virginia Cedarwood and Musk — A smooth, woody dry-down that grounds the sweetness, leaving a lingering trail of airy warmth and "second-skin" comfort.

✨ Why It’s a Modern Favorite:

  • The "Anti-Heavy" Floral: Unlike traditional, heavy rose perfumes, Irresistible is light, airy, and "bubbly." It captures the scent of a fresh bouquet without feeling dated.

  • High-Definition Sparkle: The combination of Pear and Ambrette creates a unique "shimmering" effect on the skin that is noticeable from the first spray.

  • All-Day Radiance: As an Eau de Parfum, it offers impressive longevity and a beautiful sillage that follows you throughout the day without being overwhelming.

  • Couture Bottle Design: Housed in a faceted, square glass bottle that reflects light like a prism, featuring a textured pink ribbon—a true piece of Givenchy jewelry for your vanity.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Pulse Point Radiance: Apply to the neck, wrists, and behind the ears. The warmth of your skin will help the Rose Essential and Cedarwood notes blend for a custom, magnetic aura.

  2. The "Scent Trail" Secret: Spray a light mist into your hair or on a silk scarf; the pear and iris notes stay exceptionally vibrant on hair and natural fibers.

  3. Hydrated Base: For a "glow-from-within" scent experience, apply after using a fragrance-free body oil. This helps the delicate floral notes "stick" to the skin for over 8 hours.

products.title: Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum
products.description:
thought: For your Agcosmetics.ca storefront, here is the professional, link-free description for Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum. This version offers a more concentrated, sophisticated take on the original Legend DNA, ideal for those seeking better performance and a richer scent profile.

Montblanc — Legend Eau de Parfum

Intensity Redefined. The Modern Classic, Reimagined. Building on the global success of the original, Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum is a more concentrated and magnetic version of the iconic Legend fragrance. Crafted by Master Perfumer Olivier Pescheux, this EDP retains the core character of the original while adding new, vibrant facets. It is the definitive choice for the confident, authentic man who wants his signature scent to last from a morning boardroom meeting to an evening social event.

✨ The Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: A fresh and energizing start with Bergamot and Violet Leaves. This combination is cleaner and more "green" than the original, providing an immediate sense of modern sophistication.

  • Heart Notes: The heart introduces a sophisticated floral duo of Jasmine and Magnolia, balanced by Vibrant Woodsy Notes. This adds an elegant, creamy depth that feels mature and polished.

  • Base Notes: A powerful and captivating trail of Oakmoss and Leather. This finish is darker and more robust than the EDT, leaving a memorable impression of strength and character.

✨ Why the EDP is a Powerhouse Addition:

  • Enhanced Concentration: As an Eau de Parfum, it features a higher concentration of fragrance oils, providing a richer experience and better longevity compared to the traditional Eau de Toilette.

  • A Sophisticated Evolution: While the original EDT is known for its fruity pineapple-lavender sweetness, the EDP pivots toward a "greener," woodier, and slightly more leathery profile. It is the "grown-up" version of a legendary scent.

  • The Compliment King: It maintains the high mass-appeal of the Legend line—often compared to high-end niche favorites—ensuring you smell approachable, clean, and undeniably masculine.

  • Iconic Black Lacquer Design: The bottle keeps the famous curved Meisterstück-inspired shape but is finished in a sleek, deep black lacquer with gold accents, symbolizing the power and intensity of the juice inside.

✨ Performance & Wear:

  • Long-Lasting Presence: Designed to provide 7–9 hours of wear on the skin, significantly outperforming the original EDT.

  • Perfect Versatility: Its refined, less-sweet nature makes it an incredible year-round fragrance. It is fresh enough for a professional office environment and deep enough for cooler nights or special occasions.

  • Sillage: Projects a confident, masculine aura without being overwhelming, creating a sophisticated "bubble" of fragrance around you.

✨ How to Apply for Best Results:

  1. Strategic Spraying: Because of its higher oil concentration, focus on pulse points where your skin is warmest: the sides of the neck, the chest, and the inner wrists.

  2. Layer for Longevity: Apply to skin that has been freshly moisturized with an unscented lotion to help the fragrance molecules "lock" in for even longer wear.

  3. The "Clothing" Trick: For a scent trail that lasts into the next day, apply a light mist to your collar or the inside of your jacket.

  4. Controlled Intensity: 3–4 sprays are typically the "sweet spot" for this concentrated formula to ensure you are noticed for all the right reasons.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum
products.description:

products.title: Versace Yellow Diamond Eau De Toilette
products.description:
For your Agcosmetics.ca storefront, here is the professional, link-free description for Versace Yellow Diamond. This fragrance is the "pure as sunlight" member of the Crystal collection, celebrated for its bright, airy, and sophisticated Mediterranean charm.

Versace — Yellow Diamond Eau De Toilette

Luminous. Airy. Radiant. Step into the light with Versace Yellow Diamond. Like a sudden burst of sunshine, this Eau De Toilette is a sparkling floral fragrance that is both elegant and exhilarating. It captures the glamorous spirit of the Versace woman—confident, feminine, and always shining. With its blend of crisp Mediterranean citrus and delicate blossoms, Yellow Diamond is the perfect "pick-me-out" scent for those who love a clean, high-definition floral.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Citron from Diamante, Pear Sorbet, Bergamot, and Neroli — A mouth-watering, zesty opening that is incredibly fresh and uplifting.

  • Heart Notes: Orange Blossom, Freesia, Mimosa, and Water Lily — A transparent, "dewy" floral heart that feels like a sun-drenched garden in full bloom.

  • Base Notes: Amber Wood, Palo Santo, and Musk — A sophisticated, clean, and slightly woody dry-down that ensures the brightness lingers on the skin.

✨ Why It’s a Luxury Essential:

  • The "Sunshine" Scent: Yellow Diamond is famous for its ability to cut through the heat. It is one of the most refreshing luxury florals on the market, making it the ultimate choice for spring and summer.

  • Clean-Chic Aesthetic: It avoids the "heavy" or "powdery" feel of traditional florals, opting instead for a crisp, watery texture that smells expensive and well-groomed.

  • Effortless Versatility: This is the quintessential "brunch to boardroom" fragrance. It is bright enough for a casual day out but has the sophisticated structure required for professional environments.

  • The Iconic Jewel Bottle: Housed in a brilliant yellow glass bottle topped with a massive, faceted "diamond" cap, it is a stunning centerpiece for any vanity.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Morning Application: Apply to pulse points—wrists, neck, and inner elbows—to start your day with a boost of citrus energy.

  2. Mist the Hair: For a light, breezy scent trail (sillage), lightly mist your hair or a silk scarf. The Pear Sorbet and Freesia notes stay exceptionally crisp on fibers.

  3. Layering Tip: Apply to damp skin immediately after a shower. The "watery" notes of the Mimosa and Water Lily lock in beautifully for extended wear.

products.title: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Eau de Parfum

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Sicilian Blood Orange and Spicy Ginger — A sharp, "red" opening that is both zesty and heat-inducing, providing an immediate jolt of adrenaline.

  • Heart Notes: Tunisian Orange Blossom, Sambac Jasmine, and Pimento Leaf — The signature white floral heart is "inflamed" by the inclusion of pimento leaf, adding a unique, spicy-green texture.

  • Base Notes: Indonesian Patchouli and New Caledonian Sandalwood — A suave, woody dry-down that provides a smoky, sophisticated depth and incredible longevity.

✨ Why It’s the "Vampy" Choice:

  • The Spicy-Red Accord: The combination of ginger, blood orange, and pimento leaf creates a "hot-and-cold" sensation on the skin that makes this the most sensual version in the L’Interdit lineup.

  • Sophisticated Intensity: While the original EDP is bright and "bubblegum" tuberose, Rouge is darker, woodier, and more mysterious—perfect for the woman who wants to leave a lasting impression.

  • Superior Performance: Known for its "beast-mode" sillage, this fragrance clings to skin and fabrics for 10+ hours, making it an ideal choice for nightlife and cold-weather evenings.

  • Couture Glasswork: The bottle features a translucent red internal lacquering—a world-first in perfumery—that glows from within like a forbidden gem.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Pulse Point Heat: Apply to the neck and inner wrists. The spicy ginger and blood orange notes react beautifully to body heat, creating a magnetic "scent bubble."

  2. Evening Statement: Spray 15 minutes before an event. The sharp ginger top notes will settle, allowing the creamy sandalwood and spicy pimento to take center stage for the rest of the night.

  3. Winter Layering: Lightly mist your favorite dark coat or scarf. The patchouli and sandalwood base notes are incredibly persistent on natural fibers, ensuring you carry the "thrill of the forbidden" all week long.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum
products.description:

It is a "Woody Floral Oriental" that centers around a noble iris heart, wrapped in a warm, spicy, and balsamic embrace.

✨ Fragrance Profile:

  • Top Notes: Black Pepper and Lavender — A sharp, spicy, and aromatic opening that provides an immediate, sophisticated edge.

  • Heart Notes: Iris and Orris — The soul of the Gentleman line. A rich, powdery, and buttery floral heart that adds a high-end, "niche" quality to the scent.

  • Base Notes: Black Vanilla Husk, Tolu Balsam, and Patchouli — A dark, syrupy, and sweet dry-down that provides incredible warmth, depth, and a "come-closer" appeal.

✨ Why the EDP is a Masterpiece:

  • The "Black Vanilla" Finish: Unlike standard sweet perfumes, Givenchy uses Black Vanilla Husk, which is woodier and more resinous, ensuring the scent remains mature and masculine.

  • Powdery Perfection: The use of Iris gives this fragrance a "lipstick" or "expensive leather bag" vibe that is a hallmark of luxury French perfumery.

  • Beast-Mode Performance: This is a high-concentration EDP known for its heavy sillage and 10+ hour longevity. It is a true "statement" fragrance that leaves a lasting impression.

  • The Ultimate Date Night Scent: With its warm balsam and spicy pepper, this is widely considered one of the best fragrances for evening wear, formal events, and cold-weather styling.

✨ How to Use for Best Results:

  1. Strategic Application: Focus on your pulse points—neck, chest, and wrists. The warmth of your skin will help the Tolu Balsam and Vanilla base notes "bloom" over several hours.

  2. Evening Prep: Apply 15–20 minutes before heading out. This allows the sharp black pepper to settle, letting the smooth iris and vanilla take center stage.

  3. Winter Layering: Apply to well-moisturized skin. This heavy, resinous fragrance performs exceptionally well when sprayed on a wool coat or a cashmere scarf, where it can last for days.

✨ Why It’s a Standout Flanker:

products.description:

Experience the captivating allure of the Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Profondo Eau de Parfum Spray for men. Launched in the year 2020, this fragrance takes you on a sensory journey, capturing the essence of the modern man.

Unleash your inner adventurer with the top notes of green mandarin, bergamot, and marine notes. These refreshing, crisp scents awaken the senses, providing an invigorating burst of energy. It then transitions to the heart notes of rosemary, lavender, cypress, and lentisque, offering a unique blend that is both earthy and aromatic.
